entities.name: Query IspD/IspF
observations: A 380-residue protein with Pfam IspD at positions 4–215 and YgbB at positions 224–377; NTP_transf_3 also detected at positions 5–124.
Shares 61.7–67.5% identity over 99.5–100% coverage with reviewed bacterial bifunctional IspD/IspF proteins.
Predicted molecular weight is 40.26 kDa and theoretical pI is 5.61.

entities.name: MEP cytidylyltransferase reaction
observations: 2-C-methyl-D-erythritol 4-phosphate (MEP) + CTP + H+ → 4-CDP-2-C-methyl-D-erythritol + diphosphate; EC 2.7.7.60; Rhea RHEA:13429.

entities.name: MEP isoprenoid pathway
observations: The two activities correspond to steps 2 and 4 of the methylerythritol phosphate (MEP/DOXP) pathway for isopentenyl diphosphate and terpenoid biosynthesis.

entities.name: Divalent metal cofactor
observations: The homologous bifunctional enzyme is annotated as requiring a divalent metal cation; the exact metal identity is not established for this query sequence.
